DLP Dictionary Resource Delete Custom DLP Dictionary
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dlpDictionaries/:dlpDictId

Deletes a custom DLP dictionary. You cannot delete predefined DLP dictionaries.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
dlpDictId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the DLP dictionary.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
